page.notes: Uncertain readings: "relliquum" (marked [?]); the page number "155" is hard to make out and is marked [?]. Possible printing error: "de-sperata-m" is set as printed with the line break at "de-" and "m" at the next line; I have transcribed it as the printed hyphenation of "desperatam". The mark "{r}" in the text corresponds to the margin note "§. r.". At the foot right there is a small mark "I6-" that is not clearly a catchword, so it is left out. The margin note "1. 1. Cod." is read as "l. 1." with a Latin l. The note of two lines in the margin, "1.52. §.r. D. Ad leg. A-quil.", is run together as "Aquil." in the transcription.
